srList.sentence: Inclusion criteria of this study were as follows: the pulmonary lesions were accessed to be metastases from CRC and confirmed by at least one pathologist, the LM was performed with curative intent.

srList.sentence: The exclusion criteria included other extrahepatic metastases, palliative resection, previous history of other malignant tumors, mutation of BRAF, ablation or other palliative local treatment of the metastases, and prior LM received before the first visit.
